jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
 Process and Tooling Team Introduction
 Cloud Interconnection & Acquisition | Network Fiber
 Who We Are
 We are the Process and Tooling team supporting CIA Network Fiber, focused on simplifying how teams plan, source, deliver, and manage fiber work across regions. Our team partners closely with sourcing, delivery, engineering, operations, GIS, and regional stakeholders to turn complex workflows into clear, scalable processes and practical tooling solutions.
 Our Mission
 Our mission is to create consistent, efficient, and repeatable ways of working that reduce manual effort, improve visibility, and help teams move fiber programs forward with greater speed and confidence. We focus on standardizing processes, improving tool adoption, clarifying ownership, and enabling better decision-making through reliable data and well-defined workflows.

Responsibilities
 Responsibilities:
 We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive process & tooling optimization and automation, primarily focused on AI driven improvements to accelerate transformation across global cloud and network operations.
 This role sits at the intersection of business process optimization, AI adoption, tooling, and intelligent automation engineering. You will lead the identification, development, and scaling of AI powered capabilities, process improvement and tooling requirements —embedding Copilot, automation, and predictive analytics into operational workflows to improve speed to market, data quality, cost efficiency, and decision making.
 The ideal candidate thrives in complex, matrixed environments, can move seamlessly between strategy and execution, and delivers measurable impact through responsible, scalable AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities - Process Optimization, Tooling & Automation with Focus on AI

• Map, analyze, and optimize end-to-end operational processes across network sourcing, inventory, planning, fiber lifecycle, and engineering workflows.

• Eliminate friction, standardize practices, and reduce cycle times using AI enabled automation.

• Partner with CIA and our partner teams to ensure integrated, scalable tooling solutions aligned to business priorities.
 AI, Data & System Integration

• Strengthen data quality, interoperability, and automation across network and operational tools.

• Enable AI powered data cleansing, reconciliation, forecasting, and predictive modeling.

• Support system modernization initiatives to ensure platforms are AI‑ready and interoperable.

• Act as a connector between business owners, engineering teams, and AI/data science resources.

• Design, develop, and deploy agents and agent flows that support operational workflows.

• Translate repeatable patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

• Ensure AI solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with engineering best practices.

• Integrate automation solutions with existing systems and Microsoft platforms.

• Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI and automation solutions in production environments.

• Contribute to technical documentation, operational readiness, and knowledge sharing.

• Lead AI change management efforts to drive AI literacy and adoption across teams.

• Develop training, documentation, and communications that accelerate responsible AI usage.

• Foster an AI first, growth mindset culture grounded in Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, security, and governance standards.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, Telecommunications, Finance, or related field AND some experience in these fields OR equivalent experience

• Some experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects
 Preferred Qualifications:

• Some experience in cloud, data center, or large‑scale network environments.

• Solid experience in program management, process improvement, automation, or operations.

• Hands‑on experience with AI tools, including Copilot and/or Copilot Studio.

• Experience developing automation or analytics solutions using Python or similar languages.

• Strong understanding of network or infrastructure lifecycles.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel with financial or operational data.

• Proven ability to influence across highly matrixed organizations.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience designing and implementing Copilot agents and agent flows, including prompt design.

• Familiarity with Azure services, Kusto queries, APIs, or enterprise data platforms.

• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or value‑stream mapping.

• Understanding of carrier networks, fiber delivery, or outside plant engineering.

• PMP or equivalent certification.

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics or similar enterprise systems.

• Familiarity with AI readiness assessments or enterprise AI frameworks.

jobs.title: Cloud and AI Platforms (CAIP) Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview
 Are you passionate about AI and eager to transform the IT landscape? Join our dynamic Azure team as we lead the charge in AI transformation! As trusted advisors, we help customers modernize their infrastructure, optimize operations, and drive innovation with Azure's cutting-edge AI capabilities. Whether it's migrating and modernizing estates to be AI-ready, accelerating innovation with AI agents and platforms, empowering development teams with AI, or unifying and modernizing data estates, we help customers build technology solutions to achieve their business needs.

In Cloud and AI Platforms (CAIP) Specialist role, you'll be at the forefront of AI growth and disruption, guiding customers through their AI journey and helping them achieve their strategic goals. You'll ensure customers can fully harness the transformative potential of AI to stay ahead of the competition. If you're ready to make a significant impact and drive AI transformation, we invite you to join us and be part of this exciting journey!
 As Cloud and AI Platforms (CAIP) Specialist, you will be a solution sales professional within our enterprise sales organization working with our most important customers. You will collaborate with a team of technical, partner, and consulting resources to advance the sales process and exceed quarterly Azure revenue targets in your assigned accounts.
 At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

Responsibilities
 Lead Customer Engagements: Act as the Azure sales lead, guiding customers through cloud transformation across infrastructure, data, and AI platforms. Address business and technical needs with demos, whiteboarding, and solution storytelling.
 Own and Convert Pipeline: Manage forecast and pipeline from early-stage to close. Use tools like Industry Account Plans (IAP), Landing Experience Plans (LXP), and checklists to execute territory strategies and drive revenue.
 Orchestrate Across Teams: Partner with Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Cloud Solution Architects, and partners to co-sell, validate solutions, and ensure successful deployment through the Azure Marketplace.
 Accelerate Decisions: Engage decision-makers with clear business cases using Azure Pricing Calculator, ROI, and TCO tools. Scope proofs of concept and lead customers from commitment to consumption.
 Inspire and Influence: Bring technical fluency and inclusive leadership to virtual teams. Solve challenges with expertise in virtualization, cloud-native tech, data modernization, and AI.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications (RQs)

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, and substantial technology-related sales or account management experience in a software company.

• Experience working with complex enterprise customers.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure infrastructure, data, and AI application platforms, with the ability to articulate technical solutions to both business and IT stakeholders.
 Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

• Experience selling business solutions to global customers, with a focus on cloud-native technologies, AI, data platforms, and analytics.

• Master's Degree in Business Administration (e.g., MBA), Information Technology, or a related field, and substantial technology-related sales or account management experience.

• Solid services sales experience.

• Experience working with customers in the financial services industry, including an understanding of banking and/or insurance business priorities and technology needs.

Overview
 Collaborate with brilliant minds who challenge, inspire, and elevate each other to new heights. As a Solution Engineer for Data in the Technology Sales team, you help enterprise customers reimagine what is possible with their data. You partner closely with technical and business leaders to translate complex challenges into clear solution paths, ensuring that every engagement moves customers closer to their strategic goals.

In this role, you are at the forefront of data transformation, guiding customers as they unlock value from their data estate with Microsoft Fabric, Azure databases, analytics, and artificial intelligence solutions. You lead hands-on customer engagements such as proof of concept projects, hackathons, and architecture workshops that influence technology strategy and measurable business outcomes. You build deep expertise across cloud platforms, analytics, governance, and artificial intelligence while continuously learning and shaping how organizations modernize, migrate, and innovate with their data. Join this team to accelerate customer success, expand your technical breadth, and influence how organizations build their next generation of data and artificial intelligence solutions.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

Responsibilities

• Engage proactively with customers to build credibility as a trusted advisor by combining customer context, solution expertise, and technical and industry knowledge.

• Lead technical discussions, demonstrations, and proof of concept activities to ensure technical wins for core and adjacent Microsoft technologies, establishing clear rules of engagement and handoffs across virtual teams.

• Design and present solution architectures that span data, analytics, and artificial intelligence scenarios, driving cross-workload support for Microsoft solutions that address customer modernization and migration needs.

• Act as a liaison in partner sell-with scenarios, coordinating partner and internal resources throughout engagements and identifying partner skill or resource gaps that can inform internal readiness plans.

• Capture market insights from customer engagements and feed them back to product, engineering, and account teams to refine strategies, strengthen Microsoft’s value proposition, and shape customer success and consumption plans.

 Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Master's / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
• AND several years of technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience, including several years of experience with cloud databases, analytics solutions and or databases on premises, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

• OR equivalent experience.

• This roles involves collaboration with local customers, therefore fluency in German and/or French is required.
 Preferred Qualifications

Dans l'équipe Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE), vous n'avez gagné qu'à construire un logiciel ; vous obtiendrez des résultats réels pour certaines des organisations les plus complexes du monde.

Nous sommes une équipe mondiale d'ingénieurs de classe mondiale qui travaillent dans un modèle d'ingénierie avancée déployée (FDE) depuis plus d'une décennie, intégrant directement au sein des équipes clients pour résoudre leurs défis les plus difficiles, côte à côte, et des solutions de production d'expédition prêtes en jours, pas des mois.

En tant que FDE principal de compte-aligné , vous serez un ingénieur intégré client pour servir de leader technique principal aligné sur un compte stratégique, conduisant les résultats d'affaires par des mains sur l'exécution et l'expertise multidisciplinaire. Dans ce rôle, vous allez construire et expédier des solutions de qualité de production, travailler directement avec les clients pour traduire les besoins des entreprises en approches techniques claires, et fonctionner avec rapidité dans des environnements complexes et rapides. Il s'agit d'un rôle de premier plan qui exige une forte profondeur technique, de la crédibilité auprès des principaux intervenants, du contexte de l'industrie et d'une approche entrepreneuriale de la navigation de l'ambiguïté et d'un impact soutenu au fil du temps.

La mission de Microsoft est d'habiliter chaque personne et chaque organisation de la planète à réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons à la réalisation de nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

• Conduire les résultats des clients en formant des opportunités et en traduisant les besoins des entreprises en approches techniques claires et réalisables

• Bâtir et fournir des solutions de qualité de production dans les environnements clients, démontrant une forte exécution technique et la propriété de bout en bout

• Accélérer le temps à valoriser en fonctionnant efficacement dans l'ambiguïté et en fournissant des solutions itératives à impact élevé

Overview
 In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.

As a Principal Account-Aligned FDE, you will be a customer embedded engineer to serve as the primary technical leader aligned to a strategic account, driving business outcomes through hands on execution and multidisciplinary expertise. In this role, you will build and ship production grade solutions, work directly with customers to translate business needs into clear technical approaches, and operate with speed in complex, fast moving environments. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, credibility with senior stakeholders, industry context, and an entrepreneurial approach to navigating ambiguity and delivering sustained impact over time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Drive customer outcomes by shaping opportunities and translating business needs into clear, actionable technical approaches

• Build and deliver production-grade solutions in customer environments, demonstrating strong engineering execution and end-to-end ownership

• Accelerate time to value by operating effectively in ambiguity and delivering iterative, high-impact solutions

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders to build trust, align priorities, and guide technical and business decision-making

• Apply industry and customer context to tailor solutions and move beyond generic approaches

• Prepare and transition work to FDE crews with clear scope and strong technical direction, maintaining continuity across the engagement lifecycle

• Operate with an entrepreneurial mindset to navigate complex account dynamics, set boundaries, and drive urgency and accountability.

• Embody our culture and values .

Qualifications
 Required/Minimum Qualifications (RQs/MQs)

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

• OR equivalent experience.

• Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

• OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

• Hands-on AI solution delivery experience, including building and deploying LLM-based systems, ensuring model quality and performance, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions using modern cloud AI platforms

• Enjoy travel and are comfortable with travel up to 25%

In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. • Build and deliver production-grade solutions in customer environments, demonstrating strong engineering execution and end-to-end ownership

• Accelerate time to value by operating effectively in ambiguity and delivering iterative, high-impact solutions

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders to build trust, align priorities, and guide technical and business decision-making

Dans l'équipe Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering, vous n'avez pas simplement construit de logiciel; vous aurez des résultats réels pour certaines des organisations les plus complexes du monde.

Nous sommes une équipe mondiale d'ingénieurs de calibre mondial qui travaillent dans un modèle Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) depuis plus d'une décennie, intégrant directement au sein des équipes clientes pour résoudre leurs défis les plus difficiles, côte à côte, et des solutions de production d'expédition prêtes en jours, pas des mois.

En tant que FDE principal de compte-aligné, vous serez un ingénieur intégré client pour servir de leader technique principal aligné sur un compte stratégique, conduisant les résultats d'affaires par des mains sur l'exécution et l'expertise multidisciplinaire. Dans ce rôle, vous allez construire et expédier des solutions de qualité de production, travailler directement avec les clients pour traduire les besoins des entreprises en approches techniques claires, et fonctionner avec rapidité dans des environnements complexes et rapides. Il s'agit d'un rôle de premier plan qui exige une forte profondeur technique, de la crédibilité auprès des principaux intervenants, du contexte de l'industrie et d'une approche entrepreneuriale de la navigation de l'ambiguïté et d'un impact soutenu au fil du temps.

La mission de Microsoft est de donner à chaque personne et à chaque organisation de la planète les moyens de réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons à la réalisation de nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

• Conduire les résultats des clients en formant des opportunités et en traduisant les besoins des entreprises en approches techniques claires et réalisables

• Construire et fournir des solutions de qualité de production dans les environnements clients, démontrant une forte exécution technique et la propriété de bout en bout

• Accélérer le temps à valoriser en fonctionnant efficacement dans l'ambiguïté et en fournissant des solutions itératives à impact élevé

• Engager et influencer les principaux intervenants pour établir la confiance, harmoniser les priorités et guider la prise de décisions techniques et commerciales

• Appliquer le contexte industriel et client pour adapter les solutions et dépasser les approches génériques

• Préparation et transition aux équipes de FDE avec une portée claire et une direction technique forte, en maintenant la continuité tout au long du cycle de vie de l'engagement

• Fonctionnez avec un esprit d'entreprise pour naviguer dans la dynamique complexe des comptes, établir des frontières, et stimuler l'urgence et la responsabilité.

• Embody notre culture et nos valeurs .

• Baccalauréat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe ET 6 ans d'expérience en ingénierie technique avec codage dans les langues, y compris, mais non limité à, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript ou Python

• OU expérience équivalente.

• Expérience de partenariat direct avec les clients ou les intervenants internes pour fournir des solutions de bout en bout.

• Baccalauréat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe ET 10+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie technique avec codage dans les langues, y compris, mais non limité à, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, ou Python

• OU Maîtrise en informatique ou domaine technique connexe ET 8 ans d'expérience en ingénierie technique avec codage en langues, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript ou Python

• Profitez des voyages et êtes à l'aise avec les voyages jusqu'à 25%
